jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

jobs.location: New York, New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. Director, Commissioning, EMEA

Role Summary

The Commissioning Director, EMEA will lead commissioning across STACK data centre projects, from early project engagement through testing, validation and final power and facilities handover. This role provides programme-level leadership for the planning, development and consistent execution of commissioning activities across mission-critical facilities, ensuring systems perform safely, reliably and in line with design intent and client requirements.

Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover.

· Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods.

· Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements.

· Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

· Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution.

· Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results.

· Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early.

· Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes.

· Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery.

· Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders.

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps.

· Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities.

What You’ll Bring

· Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes.

· A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems.

· Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles.

· Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings.

· Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements.

· Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance.

· Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners.

· Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%).

What We Offer

· The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA.

· The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business.

· Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. We develop, build and operate Data Centres designed to meet the scale, performance and sustainability requirements of today’s leading technology businesses. Across EMEA, our teams work together to deliver resilient, high-quality infrastructure and create long-term value for our customers and communities.

jobs.title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

  • Be responsible for defining and evolving security best practices for our systems, and for helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

Communication, quality & delivery

This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales engineering, telephony architecture, and enterprise contact center strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex, ambiguous voice deployment conversations—from SIP trunking and call routing to media handling and real-time transcription—ensuring Decagon integrates seamlessly into their existing contact center platforms while meeting latency, reliability, and compliance requirements.

You will establish technical credibility with stakeholders across the C-suite, telephony and network teams, contact center operations, and CX leadership.

In this role, you will

  • Partner with Account Executives to discover, qualify, and design voice deployment solutions that address customer telephony constraints and deliver measurable containment and CX outcomes.

  • Navigate ambiguous conversations about a customer's contact center landscape, translating diverse environments (Genesys Cloud CX & Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco UCCE/CVP, Google CCAI) into clear integration and deployment strategies for Decagon's voice platform.

  • Design SIP integration approaches—BYOC trunking, REFER-based transfer, header propagation, and media/streaming paths (Websockets, Audio Connector, External Voice Transfer)—tailored to each customer's topology and security posture.

  • Diagnose complex, multi-leg call flows down to the packet level, and establish repeatable methods for tracing and resolving SIP and media issues in production.

  • Establish scalable pre-sales processes, deployment playbooks, and reusable reference architectures to support growth.

Your background looks something like this

  • 8–10+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Manager) with a focus on voice, telephony, or contact center platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with CPaaS infrastructure such as Twilio or Telnyx, including BYOC configuration and programmable voice.

  • Demonstrated success navigating ambiguous technical conversations with enterprise customers, asking the right discovery questions, and collaborating through uncertainty.

  • Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders—from network engineers to CX and contact center leaders—and translate voice requirements into actionable deployment strategies.

Even better if you have

  • Experience in a high-growth startup where you built pre-sales practices from the ground up.

  • Hands-on packet-level SIP diagnostics experience (pcap analysis, Wireshark/Scapy) and comfort reading raw signaling.

  • Familiarity with real-time speech stacks (STT/TTS), call recording and compliance patterns (SIPREC), and multi-leg call correlation.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (AI/ML)
jobs.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Purpose

The Manager, Procurement Operations & Transformation will be the functional owner responsible for both the strategic evolution and the daily operational execution of Checkout.com’s Procurement and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) functions.

The role is structured across four core pillars:

  • Transformation: Setting the long-term vision, target operating model, and multi-year transformation initiatives, roadmaps, business cases, and cost-benefit analyses across all operating model components: Service Delivery Model, People, Process, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Operations: Managing the day-to-day Procurement Operations team, monitoring functional health, data quality, and operational metrics, as well as eliminating bottlenecks and escalations across sourcing and corporate travel.

  • Business Partnering: Acting as the primary strategic bridge between Procurement and core business functions (Technology, InfoSec, Risk, Legal, and People) to ensure cross-functional alignment and service delivery.

  • Program Management & Governance: Leading programmatic execution, centralizing compliance and regulatory inputs, servicing audit requirements, and managing functional roadmaps with support teams.

The primary objective is to modernize Procurement and TPRM into high-performing service functions delivering superior customer experience, strict SLAs, advanced automation, and scalable tooling architectures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation & Operating Model Strategy

  • Define and execute the global strategy, target operating model, and vision across all Procurement & TPRM components: Service Delivery Model, Process, People, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Map strategy into prioritized roadmaps supported by concrete business cases and cost-benefit analyses.

  • Define the functional AI and automation strategy, sponsoring the delivery of automated capabilities in partnership with Technology to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Establish and monitor core operational metrics, KPIs, and SLAs to track function health, service quality, and risk posture.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable to drive end-to-end Source-to-Pay process optimization and touchless execution.

2. Operational Leadership & Escalation Management

  • Lead and manage the Procurement Operations team, ensuring category management teams receive required data, analytics, and operational support.

  • Own vendor master data governance to maintain maximum accuracy and integrity across downstream systems and reporting.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for operational blockers across Procurement, corporate travel, and P2P handoffs.

  • Maintain functional relationships with platform providers and monitor tooling health, releases, and integrations in collaboration with Technology.

3. Tooling Ecosystem Ownership

  • Zip: Act as joint business owner with Accounts Payable, functionally managing intake-to-contract workflows, vendor onboarding, and P2P handoffs.

  • OneTrust: Functionally own TPRM risk assessment workflows and vendor risk oversight.

  • Navan: Functionally oversee corporate travel management tools, user support, and policy administration.

  • Partner with Technology on business requirement definitions (BRDs), backlog prioritization, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

4. Regulatory, Compliance & Audit Enablement

  • Act as the functional Procurement lead for internal and external audits, SOX controls, and regulatory assessments.

  • Deliver operational support for global market expansion, ensuring supply-chain and TPRM standards satisfy new market license applications and regulatory filings.

  • Programmatically centralize, manage, and track regulatory, audit, and compliance inputs and remediation actions across the team.

Requirements

  • Transformation & Operating Model Leadership: Proven track record designing, delivering, and scaling target operating models, large-scale procurement transformations, and process re-engineering in fast-paced enterprise environments.

  • Procurement Operations & People Management: Demonstrated experience leading a Procurement Operations team, driving daily operational discipline, and resolving cross-functional bottlenecks.

  • Tooling & Digital Enablement: Hands-on functional ownership, administration, or implementation experience with modern enterprise platforms: Zip, OneTrust, and Navan (or comparable modern P2P and TPRM tools).

  • Automation & AI Strategy: Proven ability to identify, scope, and sponsor automation and AI initiatives, partnering closely with Technology and Engineering to deliver technical solutions.

  • TPRM & Regulatory Governance: Strong background in Third-Party Risk Management frameworks, regulatory compliance requirements, and audit management.

  • Program Management: Strong capability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programmatic roadmaps and drive alignment across Finance, Legal, Risk, and Technology.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operating Model Transformation: Multi-year transformation roadmap is executed efficiently, delivering measurable productivity gains and modernizing the functional architecture across Procurement and TPRM.

  • Automation & AI Execution: Automation and AI use cases are successfully delivered alongside Technology, driving touchless handoffs, faster cycle times, and optimized workflows.

  • Operational Excellence: Operational SLAs and KPIs are consistently achieved, vendor master data maintains high integrity, and operational bottlenecks are rapidly resolved.

  • Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Zero critical audit findings across Procurement and TPRM operations, with dependable operational execution for international license applications and filings.

  • High-Performing Operations Team: An engaged, well-structured Procurement Operations team that consistently provides reliable, high-quality operational support to category managers and internal stakeholders.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer (Lab Integration)
jobs.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

We are seeking a Scientific Software Engineer to build and run the systems that connect our AI platform to physical laboratories around the world. Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments.

This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners.

You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will help define how our AI platform connects to the physical world and shape the tools and practices that link external partner labs to our platform. You will thrive here if you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and learning from people whose expertise differs from your own.

Your Impact

You will turn experimental labs into first-class, programmable parts of the CuspAI platform. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material.

What You Will Do

  • Help shape how we connect to partner labs around the world, accounting for different levels of automation and AI-readiness, then design, build and operate the services that send experiment requests from our AI agents and reliably bring results back.

  • Build APIs and data models (e.g. FastAPI, Pydantic) for bidirectional lab-to-cloud data exchange.

  • Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform.

  • Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones.

  • Assist with the technical onboarding of new lab partners, assessing their systems and setting up integrations quickly and repeatedly.

  • Collaborate day to day with experimental materials scientists, optimisation experts and engineers on the team, co-designing workflows and feeding lab realities back into platform design.

  • Deploy and run containerised services on cloud infrastructure, with testing and CI/CD as standard.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with lab automation, self-driving labs or other scientific discovery workflows, e.g. instrument control, robotic platforms, or high-throughput experimentation data pipelines.

  • Strong software engineering background, with production experience building and operating backend services.

  • Deep fluency in Python, including typed, well-tested code and API design.

  • Experience designing distributed systems that integrate with external parties: APIs, message queues or event-driven architectures, and data contracts.

  • Solid understanding of security practices for externally facing systems.

  • A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working in a small, multidisciplinary team, and can communicate clearly with experimental scientists, optimisation experts and engineers alike.

Bonus Points

  • Experimental lab experience in materials science, chemistry or chemical engineering.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Flyte, Prefect) or active learning loops.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and observability tooling.

  • Security or compliance experience or handling partner IP and confidential data.

  • Experience working across distributed teams and multiple time zones.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. 

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

  • System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques.

  • Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation. 

  • State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints. 

  • Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle.   • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions.

jobs.description:
Role: Senior Sustainability Manager, Climate & Circularity

Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent

Location: The role can be based out of either Sunbury-upon-Thames, London (UK) or in New Jersey, Washington or Boston (we operate a hybrid working arrangement allowing for a mix of home and office working requiring a minimum of 2 days in the office per week)

Interview Process: 2 stages 

**Please note Kinly will not be engaging any recruitment agency for this assignment**

 

Kinly is a leading integrator of audio-visual and unified communications solutions, and the largest in Europe, serving as a globally trusted technology advisor to leading organisations. For more than 25 years, we have been designing, developing, integrating and supporting complex audiovisual solutions and businesses rely on us to deliver consistently secure and flexible meeting experiences.

Kinly is developing a new Group-wide sustainability strategy that builds on the strong sustainability foundations and achievements established across the business to date. As we bring together our global operations, we are creating a unified approach to sustainability that supports our business objectives, strengthens ESG performance, and responds to growing customer and stakeholder expectations.

A key focus of the strategy is accelerating our decarbonisation journey through robust emissions management, science-based target implementation, and enhanced disclosure of our environmental performance, so we are looking for an experienced, proactive and driven Senior Sustainability Manager to become a key member of Kinly's sustainability function.

Key responsibilities:

  • Reporting to the VP Global Sustainability, this role will be vital in shaping and delivering Kinly's climate and circularity agenda while contributing to the broader development and implementation of the Group's sustainability strategy; so this will combine technical expertise with the ability to engage stakeholders across the business, translating sustainability ambitions into practical actions that deliver measurable environmental impact and support long-term business success.

  • Drive the development and implementation of Kinly's global decarbonisation programme, including coordination of emissions reduction initiatives and alignment with science-based targets.

  • Manage the annual collection, validation and analysis of Scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas emissions data across the organisation. Support external assurance and verification activities.

  • Contribute to climate-related assessments, including climate scenario analysis and the financial assessment of climate risks and opportunities.

  • Manage the revalidation of Kinly’s emissions reduction targets through the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), reflecting the expanded Group boundary following recent merger activities.

  • Drive resource efficiency and circular economy initiatives across client projects, working closely with operational and commercial teams.

  • Contribute to environmental and climate-related data collection and standard setting within the supply chain, in close collaboration with procurement.

  • Support external disclosures such as CDP, EcoVadis and sustainability reporting.

  • Monitor emerging sustainability regulations, reporting requirements and industry best practices relevant to climate and circularity.

 

Essential skills and experience:

  • Proven experience in environmental management, carbon accounting, corporate sustainability or a related field.

  • Proven experience supporting science-based target implementation or corporate decarbonisation programmes.

  • Strong understanding of greenhouse gas accounting principles, including Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and the GHG Protocol.

  • Strong knowledge of climate target-setting and disclosure frameworks, particularly SBTi and CDP, with familiarity with TCFD-aligned climate reporting.

  • Understanding of circular economy principles, product lifecycle impacts and resource efficiency initiatives.

  • Analytical and quantitative skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and experience using carbon accounting platforms.

  • Experience engaging with cross-functional stakeholders to drive sustainability outcomes.

  • Ability to communicate complex sustainability topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line.   • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

  • You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings.

Bonus points

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.


Recent projects run by interns:

  • Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34.

  • Took a new product from first customer call to production launch.

  • Relaunched our CRM to drive data accuracy.

  • Built the sales case behind our largest deals.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

  • You can build workflows in n8n/zapier/make.

  • You are comfortable talking to senior leaders, external partners, and candidates from day one.

  • You are genuinely excited about what we are building.

This is not for you if:

  • You only want to work on strategic projects.

  • You need to know exactly what you will be working on before you join.

  • You are looking for a 9-5 role.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, or consulting and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations, research, or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • You are available for 4 months.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

What You Get

Who you'll learn from:

  • Every intern is mentored by a founder or executive.

  • A peer buddy for day-to-day questions.

  • A 1:1 with one of our VC investors or angels.

Your setup:

  • A dedicated stipend covering unlimited AI token usage for your work.

What comes after:

  • Exceed our expectations and you can convert to full-time, or stay on as a working student.

 

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.

In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.

You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

  • Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

  • Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

  • You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

jobs.description:
Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 München/Süddeutschland: Homeoffice plus Kundentermine in deiner Region, monatliche Teamtage in Berlin.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Firms-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort Remote Deutschland: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice in einer Region mit vielen Steuerkanzleien. Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das ganze deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.
